articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.snippet: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: Payments platform Decta explores stablecoin-enabled treasury settlement
articles.snippet: Decta will use USDC through OpenPayd’s infrastructure for international treasury settlement, seeking faster transfers and more efficient liquidity management.

articles.title: Tron USDT supply hits $87.9B as transfers reach $2.1T in Q2: Messari
articles.snippet: Messari reported that Tron recorded all-time highs in stablecoin supply and network activity during the second quarter, while DeFi and decentralized exchange activity declined.
